title: Employer Group Contracts: Employer Termination Notice Terms
content:
The written notice an employer gives to end an Employer Group Contract, and the date on which the contract then ends, follow the same terms in every Cascade Group Dental & Vision segment.

| Segment | Written notice the employer must give | When the contract ends | Employer may end the contract before the end of a rate guarantee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 2-19 | 30 calendar days | end of the month after notice | Yes |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 20-49 | 30 calendar days | end of the month after notice | Yes |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 50-99 | 30 calendar days | end of the month after notice | Yes |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 100-249 | 30 calendar days | end of the month after notice | Yes |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 250-999 | 30 calendar days | end of the month after notice | Yes |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 1000 Plus | 30 calendar days | end of the month after notice | Yes |

- **Written notice**: the calendar days of written notice the employer must give to end the contract.
- **End of the month after notice**: the contract ends on the last day of the month in which the notice period ends.
- **Early termination (Yes)**: the employer may end the contract before the end of a rate guarantee on notice.
